requested_input: Choose one, or state another disposition (recorded verbatim with resolve_human_intervention; it changes no recorded verdict — V5, V11, V10-A, V6/V6-sens and V7-R stay failed under every option): (A) RECOMMENDED — closure with a reduced gate set per Amendment 20 (b‴)4, committed only after your approval: 1. V5 and V11 removed from the Option II gate set and carried as recorded failures next to the attribution record (Amendment 19 (d)) and the M2/M3/M2′ outcomes; 2. the elastic channel ships as a flagged option with the declared limitation "elastic depth-dose effect over-corrected against TOPAS by 3.7–4.9 % in peak/plateau; no validated depth-dose claim" — (b‴)4 requires the closure proposal to choose default-off or default-on; default-off is recommended because no unvalidated model should be on by default, not because its depth dose is better (both carry a V5 failure: off +12.5/+12.3 %, on −3.7/−4.9 %); 3. remaining gates at one evidence SHA: V6-F (binding, once at base 20551004; it runs elastic-on through the D-1 table, so its reduced-scope halo claim certifies the elastic-on configuration only — the default configuration has no halo gate), V7-R2 in V7-R's slot, V8-nuc, and the implementation gates P6-D, P7, P5-ext, C1-ext, R1-D2, V8-LV, CI; 4. claims: no elastic depth-dose claim, no lateral-halo claim beyond V6-F's reduced scope, no measured-dose claim from V6, V10-A report-only; 5. budget (Amendment 20 (b‴)4 item 6): V6-F ≈ 6.15 h CPU + ≈ 0.16 h CUDA, V7-R2 block ≈ 33.9 h, remaining lv5d/hr5d rows ≤ 3.28 h, total ≈ 43.5 h, one heavy job at a time under the stability restrictions; 6. requirements recorded as NOT MET and NOT WAIVED (your 2026-10-18 response "does not waive any final experiment requirement"): S-PHYS-PROTON-NUCLEAR and V1-MUST-005/V1-MUST-013/V1-MUST-014 per (b‴)4 item 5 — merging under (A) carries them as unmet requirements, open for a later task and the final qualification; 7. removing V11 partly reverses the 2B treatment you selected. (B) Operator-assisted M3 route: you enable acquisition of the ENDF/B-VIII.0 neutron files C-12 MAT 625 and O-16 MAT 825 (raise the tool's 256 MiB cap, or place the files manually); the orchestrator builds and verifies M3 (Amendment 20 (b″)4) and runs the same screen. Honest prognosis: the files' energy coverage at 135–200 MeV is unverified; the four tested shapes, including Geant4's, all failed the 200 MeV gain clause, so M3 passing it is not expected but not excluded; cost: infrastructure action, then minutes of sandbox time, host time only on CONTINUE. (C) No integration: PR #82 stays open and V3-005 remains unmerged (the default if unanswered). Not proposed: a third-generation model; a p-p cross-section change (the open finding H3 would need its own pre-registered investigation, a reviewed physics reason and a new amendment).
